summary: English and Arabic first-party discovery identified REGA and the Real Estate Registry. Official REGA material describes a geospatial portal covering land parcels and spatial search, and a Qassim notice explicitly includes Al Durrah neighborhood in Unaizah. The current public map page returned HTTP 503; rer.sa public lookups loaded but exposed no parcel ID-plus-geometry route. No geometry sample was retained.
queryAndRequestOutcomes: All executed discovery queries, URLs, direct requests, response outcomes, schema/CRS checks, safe field allowlist, scope limits, and uncertainty are recorded in city-2115-unaizah.json. No login, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, credentials, private tokens, TLS bypass, or unsafe-field request occurred.
